### Reuben's Mandrakes
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/reubens-mandrakes
Passage: Genesis 30:14–18
Points:
- Envy and marital tension between Rachel and Leah boiled over when Rachel demanded Reuben's harvested mandrakes.
- Both sisters relied on superstition by putting their hope in fertility plants instead of seeking God's blessing.
- Leah and Rachel treated marriage and sexual intimacy as a mere commodity to be bartered.
- God proved human superstitions futile by granting conception to Leah, the one who surrendered the fruit.
- Christians must reject superstitious practices and place full confidence in God's sovereign will.
